title: Alternative Gunpowder Crafting
description: A mod that makes obtaining gunpowder much easier
body:
A mod that makes it much easier to get gunpowder, so you don't have to spend hours killing poor creepers. It's a great addition to military mods, such as this excellent project:
https://modrinth.com/project/fTjPahkb
